messages.subject: Pennington v Tregarth - Defence served
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

We attach our client's Defence, served today. In summary our client denies that specification ES-4471 was incorporated, denies breach, raises misapplication (axial pre-load, over-temperature, lubrication) and contends your client accepted the goods and lost any right to reject.

Yours faithfully,
Geraint Tindale

messages.subject: FW: Pennington v Tregarth - Defence served
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Defence in. Three live issues: (1) incorporation of ES-4471 - the Tovey email is our answer; (2) misapplication - Renwick has already excluded those mechanisms; (3) acceptance/loss of right to reject - we say the defect was latent, only manifesting on failure from September. I'll draft a Reply pleading the Tovey estoppel and the latency point.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
